title: Floaters
blurb: Set against the UK’s sewage crisis, *Floaters* is a coming-of-age revenge caper – funny, filthy and quietly furious about the state of the nation’s rivers.
Published in a 215-copy art edition – one for every mile of the Thames – with half of all profits going to Surfers Against Sewage.
